### <a id="connector-id"></a>`connector_id`

The identifier of the meter connector instance that produced the metric.

- **Value Type:** string
- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Examples:** `0b8f4a6e-2c1d-4e5f-9a7b-3c6d8e1f2a4b`

A UUID assigned when the connector instance is created.

### <a id="signoz-io-workload"></a>`signoz.io/workload`

The SigNoz workload a Kubernetes node is dedicated to.

- **Value Type:** string
- **Stability:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)
- **Examples:** `clickhouse`

The value of the node's `signoz.io/workload` label.

Known values: `clickhouse`, `redpanda`, `consumers`, `zookeeper`,
`gateway`, `signoz`.

### <a id="signoz-meter-metric-datapoint-count"></a>`signoz.meter.metric.datapoint.count`

| Name | Instrument Type | Unit (UCUM) | Description | Stability | Entity Associations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signoz.meter.metric.datapoint.count` | Counter | `1` | The number of metric data points observed. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |  |

A gauge or sum data point counts as one. A histogram data point counts
as its number of buckets plus one for its count and one each for its
sum, min and max when present.
A summary data point counts as its number of quantiles plus two.
Exponential histogram data points, and metrics whose name starts with
`signoz` or `otelcol`, are not counted.
